subject: [Encord] Physical AI Panel @ AWS Loft 04/15
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well! We're hosting an intimate Physical AI event with our
investors from Next47 on April 15th at the AWS Loft in SF (capping
attendance to 40), and we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can
make it!

It'll run from 5:30-8:30pm, kicking off with a panel discussion on Physical
AI - hearing perspectives on building, scaling, and investing in the space.
Panelists include CxOs from Skydio, Archetype AI, our Co-Founder [SENDER], and
moderated by Colton Dempsey, Partner @ Next47.

Following the panel, we've planned an informal networking session with
refreshments - bringing together technical leaders from Ambi Robotics, 1X,
Figure AI, Shield AI, Physical Intelligence, etc.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (recently raised
a $30M Series B) focused on streamlining data curation, annotation,
workflow management, and model evaluation in one platform.

Should be a great evening - let me know if you're available & I'll reserve
you a spot / send over an invite.

subject: Met Margaret & Victoria | Working w/ Captions & Synthesia
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I recently met Margaret & Victoria from your team who mentioned the team's might be using Labelbox. We actually work closely with Synthesia & Captions who moved over from LB to improve the quality of their multimodal AI models.

We're seeing more sophisticated teams turning to us to advance model training with post-training flows like RLHF using Likert scales or curating multimodal data. Thought this could be relevant to your work on the Multilingual / Scribe models. 

Keen to chat either way and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20 mins catch up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Working w/ Captions & Synthesia | State of Marketing & AI report
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I just read Canva's State of Marketing & AI report-it looks like GenAI (text-to-image, text-to-video, multimodal AI, etc.) is a strategic focus for [YEAR]. We collaborate closely with GenAI marketing teams at Synthesia, Flawless AI, and Captions to enhance the quality of their multimodal AI models through post-training flows like RLHF with Likert scales, advanced multimodal data curation, and active learning.

I've been following (and using) Canva for a while, so I'd love to chat and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute catch-up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Working w/ Riot Games & EA | [COMPANY] La Forge
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I came across [COMPANY]'s research with La Forge & [SENDER] Clark's initiative to build a federated data mesh model across the company, so thought I'd reach out since we're working w/ some of your peers at Riot Games & EA on similar projects. 

We're primarily partnering to democratize access to data with the goal of facilitating the adoption of AI/ML, specifically multimodal AI (text, video, audio, etc.), into products. This includes leveraging sophisticated multimodal data visualization and curation techniques, as well as accelerating R&D efforts by enabling easy testing and monitoring of new projects and ideas.

I've been following [COMPANY] for a while, so I'd love to chat and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute catch-up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Encord <> [COMPANY] | Catch-up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well. My team was in touch 2 years ago about the labelling tool
you were looking for. At the time, automated labelling was a focus rather
than human-in-the-loop labeling/workflow management. I usually see teams
start with this automated labelling and then transition to needing higher
quality human annotations for quality control integrated.

Wondered if this was the case for you and the team yet? If so, would be
happy to reconnect to provide you an update on our product.

text:
